dedupeText: 90s urban r b album aesthetic 90s r b urban night photography low angle portrait condensed sans serif mirrored typography warm street lighting subject centered and dominant in the foreground car hood providing a reflective metallic base warm amber highlights contrasting with cool silver and black tones typography layered directly over the subject s torso combine a low angle urban night portrait with a two tier typographic overlay where the bottom line is a mirrored reflection of the top line s placement

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-lens portrait of a subject leaning against a vintage silver car at night, characterized by warm streetlamp glows, high-contrast shadows, and a distinct two-tier typographic layout featuring a mirrored secondary line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and dominant in the foreground
Car hood providing a reflective metallic base
Warm amber highlights contrasting with cool silver and black tones
Typography layered directly over the subject's torso
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Grainy film texture with soft-focus background
Warm, directional lighting from street lamps
Horizontal typographic band across the upper-middle third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the vertical center, leaning forward toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark clothing and the car's headlights create strong focal points in the lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the car, then returns to the bold horizontal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with the subject and the vehicle.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Metallic silver of the car and warm amber/orange from street lighting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold/yellow used for the secondary mirrored text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright car hood and dark clothing; saturation is concentrated in the warm skin tones and amber lights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant modern digital colors

characterSpecificRedesigns: Secondary line is vertically flipped (mirrored) and placed directly below the primary line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, dark condensed sans-serif with a lighter, colored, mirrored sans-serif.

preserve: Condensed proportions of the main title
The mirrored effect of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed uppercase aesthetic of the primary text.
Provides the necessary grotesque sans-serif structure.
Suitable for the secondary line due to its geometric clarity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle, wide-angle 90s film photograph of a person in black streetwear leaning against the hood of a silver 1990s sedan at night. The scene is lit by warm amber streetlights creating a hazy glow. The background shows blurry city buildings at dusk.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, condensed black sans-serif title in all caps across the center. Directly underneath, add a secondary line of text in muted gold, title case, but flipped vertically so it appears mirrored.

verificationChecks: Is the secondary text vertically mirrored?
Is the lighting warm and reminiscent of 90s street photography?
Is the primary font heavy and condensed?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the mirrored text
mustRedesign: Identifiable brand emblems on the car
Exact facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Authentic 90s film grain and color grading
avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Calibri

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not have a drop shadow
Check that the car headlights have a realistic soft glow
Verify the mirrored text is legible despite being flipped
Confirm the color palette stays within warm ambers and cool silvers
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle urban night portrait with a two-tier typographic overlay where the bottom line is a mirrored reflection of the top line's placement.
